sentences.text: The holotype specimen, which serves as the primary example for the species, contains a partial skeleton featuring skull fragments, vertebrae, limb bones, and over one hundred twenty bony plates.
Its scientific name merges the location of its discovery in Yuxi, China, with the Greek term for lizard.
Researchers classified it within the class Ornithischia and the broader group Thyreophoroidea as a basal member of the Thyreophora.
Statistical analyses suggest it is the earliest-diverging member of the Parankylosauria, though this finding lacks strong support and places that group outside Ankylosauria.
This animal inhabited the Fengjiahe Formation of southwestern China between 192.9 and 184.2 million years ago during the Early Jurassic.
There is ongoing uncertainty regarding the exact placement of Parankylosauria, with some studies suggesting an unresolved relationship involving Eurypoda and Yuxisaurus.
